mapper.sql: p.id, p.public_id, p.type, p.title, p.description, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, l.name AS location_name, p.detail AS location_detail, p.brand, p.color, p.status, p.audit_status, p.contact_mode, p.match_count, u.public_id AS publisher_public_id, p.event_time, p.expire_at, p.created_at
FROM item_post p INNER JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN campus_location l ON l.id = p.location_id
p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CLAIMING', 'CLAIMED') AND (p.expire_at IS NULL OR p.expire_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
